Entries.Text: Enable Viewport Movement
The button that is pressed down to enable viewport movement input.
Select Map Object
The button that is pressed down to select a map object in the viewport.
Interact with Gizmo
The button that is pressed down to interact with a gizmo control.
Start Box Drag
The button that is pressed down to signal the start of the box selection drag.
End Box Drag
The button that is released to signal the end of the box selection drag.
Display Viewport Context Menu
The button that is pressed down to open the viewport context menu.
Select Map in World Map
The button that picks the maps under the cursor in the Map Information window's World Map mode, to load from Selected Tiles.
Start World Map Drag
The button that is pressed down to signal the start of the world map drag.
End World Map Drag
The button that is released to signal the end of the world map drag.
Paint Map Information
The button held down to paint, fill or pick with the current tool in the Map Information Editor.
Pick Map Information Value
The button that picks the value under the cursor as the paint value in the Map Information Editor, whatever the tool.
Pan Map Information
The button held down to drag the map in the Map Information Editor.
